placements.why: This envelope's content is a database platform migration decision with performance/cost justification and a delivery timeline — an organizational-strategy category (infrastructure/architecture decisions) that nothing in the empty strata list yet covers. No existing strata or leaf holds this; minting the foundational category is required before the narrative leaves that nest under it.
placements.title: Technical infrastructure choices as an organizational category
placements.frame: What infrastructure and platform decisions, and their stated justifications, does the organization track over time?

placements.title: Platform migrations get decided and named, not merely proposed
placements.frame: When does a technical migration cross from proposal into a decision, and who is carried as its principal across restatements?
placements.why: src-1 is Dave's direct present-tense declarative performing the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch as a settled course change; src-3 restates the identical migration as a bolded, animator-authored heading with Dave as principal; src-5 sets the Q3 2026 delivery timeline for that same decision. Conviction reads all three as decision-grade rather than claim-grade, and the position pass already tracked src-1/src-3 as the same commitment surviving a footing shift. This is a subject future envelopes about infrastructure decisions will keep feeding (new migrations, timeline slips, ratification), not a one-time fact, so it clears the narrative grain test. No existing leaf or strata name covers it, so it mints fresh under the newly minted Architecture strata.

placements.title: Quantified gains are offered to justify infrastructure change
placements.frame: What quantified performance or cost claims accompany a technical decision, and does their scope hold steady or narrow as they are restated?
placements.why: src-2 is Dave's direct paired claim (10x performance, lower licensing cost) functioning as rational-persuasion/reward justification for the migration; src-4 isolates the performance figure alone as a bolded, animator-authored restatement with Dave as principal, dropping the cost claim. Both sit at claim-grade conviction per the conviction pass, and the position pass already tracked them as the same justificatory claim surviving a footing shift with a narrowing of scope. This is a recurring subject — justificatory claims for infrastructure changes — that future envelopes will keep feeding, not a single fact, so it mints as its own leaf under Architecture rather than being absorbed into the migration-decision leaf, since the justification and the decision are distinct thematic threads even when they co-occur.
